Free Security Apps
Security and spyware protection is one area where you usually 
don't want to scrimp. Luckily, there are several great free 
programs that provide basic security coverage for Windows users. 
>From blocking intrusions and removing spyware to detecting
viruses and encrypting your data, this collection of free
security tools will keep you safe and secure.
Spybot is back in the Top 10 most popular downloads once again, 
jumping two places to grab the No. 9 spot. GOM Media Player leads 
this week's Top Movers, climbing three spots to No. 16.
This week on Crossfade TV, we've got the brand-new Gnarls Barkley
single "Run," acoustic sounds from 12-string guitarist James
James Blackshaw and new hip-hop from Boston's Akrobatik. Help save the
life of a carnival fortune teller in the puzzle game "Mystery Case
Files: Madame Fate," our Game of the Week.
Happy downloading!



Mark SikesAssociate Producer,CNET Download.com
